name: orthoappeals-browser-capture
description: Repo-local Playwright capture that emits the Plinth synthetic-emr trajectory contract for a real UHC policy-retrieval browse.
playwrightResolution: The @playwright/test module is resolved at runtime from the Plinth app's node_modules (NODE_PATH set by scripts/emit_plinth_trace.py) so we do not duplicate the ~big install; a local `npm install` here also works. The browser itself is snap chromium (/snap/bin/chromium) driven via Playwright executablePath, or the ms-playwright bundled chromium if downloaded.
